_comment: Obsidian Color Math factory default configuration. This file serves as an immutable reference. To customize settings, use the in-app plugin Settings tab or edit 'data.json'. If 'data.json' has syntax errors or missing keys, Color Math safely falls back to these defaults.

_role_descriptions.main: Primary expression and function identifiers (e.g. f(x), \sin, \cos).
_role_descriptions.orange: Universal constants, coefficients, and major bounded operators (e.g. \pi, \hbar, \sum, \int, \lim).
_role_descriptions.dot: Scalar multiplication products and tensor contractions (e.g. \cdot, \times, \otimes).
_role_descriptions.derivative: Differential operators (e.g. \frac{df}{dx}, \frac{\partial\psi}{\partial t}, \nabla) and prime order markers (e.g. f'(x)).
_role_descriptions.chain: Bound summation/product indices (e.g. i, j) and inner chain rule factors (e.g. g(x) in f(g(x))).
_role_descriptions.upper: Exponent powers and outer tensor/matrix transpose indices (e.g. x^2, A^T, \mathbf{v}^\top).
_role_descriptions.relation: Binary algebraic relations, inequalities, and asymptotic bounds (e.g. =, \approx, \le, \ge, \sim, \equiv).
_role_descriptions.arrow: Morphisms, limit trajectories, vector directions, and logical implications (e.g. \to, \mapsto, \implies).
_role_descriptions.spacing: LaTeX structural spacing and micro-typography formatting commands (e.g. \quad, \;, \!).
_role_descriptions.parameter: Continuous parameters, manifold coordinates, and Greek coefficients (e.g. \alpha, \beta, \theta, \lambda, \omega).
_role_descriptions.unit: Physical dimensional units and SI metric prefixes bound to numerical scalars (e.g. \text{kg}, \text{m/s}, \mu\text{m}, \text{GHz}).
_role_descriptions.energyOperator: Canonical quantum mechanics operators (Energy: i\hbar\partial_t, Momentum: -i\hbar\nabla, Kinetic: -\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\nabla^2).

_unicode_descriptions.greekStyle: Selects between Plane 1 Mathematical Italic Symbols (U+1D400–U+1D7FF) and Standard BMP Greek (U+0370–U+03FF) for Unicode conversion. Conversion occurs in-memory with zero typing overhead.
_unicode_descriptions.convertDefiniteIntegrals: Controls conversion of bounded integrals (\int_a^b) to Unicode (∫_a^b). Keeping this OFF preserves LaTeX commands for proper displaystyle vertical limit placement in TeX engines.
_unicode_descriptions.convertBoundedOperators: Controls conversion of bounded summation and product operators (\sum_{i=1}^n) to Unicode (∑_{i=1}^n). Keeping this OFF preserves LaTeX commands for centered vertical limit layout.
_unicode_descriptions.convertProseToUnicode: Scans prose text outside math delimiters to transform LaTeX commands into Unicode glyphs, strictly isolating markdown code spans (`...`) and fenced blocks. Single-pass regex scan executes in milliseconds.
_unicode_descriptions.convertProseToLatex: Reverses Unicode mathematical symbols in prose back to canonical LaTeX commands, strictly protecting code spans and fenced blocks. Executes in milliseconds with zero note corruption.
